data.name: Ibrahimah
data.gender_notes: Ibrahimah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ibrahimah is the feminine form of Ibrahim, meaning 'father of many' or 'exalted father'. It is a revered name in Islamic tradition, associated with the Prophet Ibrahim (AS) and symbolizing spiritual leadership and compassion. The name Ibrahimah carries the meaning “Female version of Ibrahim” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ibrahimah usually hope their child will grow to embody female version of ibrahim and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Ibrahimah embodies the qualities of the Prophet Ibrahim (AS), who was known for his unwavering trust in Allah and his role as a leader and guide for his people.
data.etymology: Ibrahimah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Female version of Ibrahim.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ibrahimah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: إبراهيمة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من إبراهيم، يعني أم أو رئيسة القوم
in_arabic.long_meaning: إبراهيمة هو اسم مؤنث مشتق من اسم إبراهيم، الذي هو نفسه مشتق من الجذر العربي 'أ-ب-ر-هـ' والذي يعني 'أم أو رئيسة القوم'. ويرتبط هذا الاسم بالشخصية النبيلة لإبراهيم عليه السلام، الذي يعتبره المسلمون نبيًا ورسولًا. تحمل صاحبة هذا الاسم صفات مثل القيادة والرأي الحسن.

in_urdu.name: ابراہیمہ
in_urdu.meaning: ابراہیم کی نسائی شکل، قوم کی رہنما یا بڑی
in_urdu.long_meaning: ابراہیمہ ایک نسائی نام ہے جو ابراہیم سے ماخوذ ہے، جو خود عربی جڑ 'أ-ب-ر-هـ' سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'باپ یا رہنما'۔ اسلامی روایت میں، ابراہیم علیہ السلام ایک نبی اور رسول کے طور پر اعزاز رکھتے ہیں۔ اس نام کی مالک میں قیادت کی صلاحیت اور اچھے مشورے کی صفات پائی جاتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: इब्राहिमा
in_hindi.meaning: इब्राहिम का स्त्रीलिंग, समुदाय की मुखिया या बड़ी
in_hindi.long_meaning: इब्राहिमा एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो इब्राहिम से लिया गया है, जो अरबी जड़ 'أ-ب-ر-هـ' से उत्पन्न हुआ है जिसका अर्थ है 'पिता या नेता'। इस्लामी परंपरा में, इब्राहिम एक नबी और रसूल के रूप में सम्मानित हैं। इस नाम की धारिका में नेतृत्व क्षमता और अच्छी सलाह देने की विशेषता होती है।

in_pashto.name: ابراهیمه
in_pashto.meaning: د ابراهيم ښځینه بڼه، د قوم مشرې یا لويه
in_pashto.long_meaning: ابراهیمه د ابراهيم څخه اخیستل شوی ښځینه نوم دی، چې پخپله د عربي ريښې 'أ-ب-ر-هـ' څخه راوړل شوی دی، چې معنی یې 'مور یا مشرې' ده. په اسلامي دود کې، ابراهيم د نبي او رسول په توګه درناوی کیږي. دغه نوم د هغې خاوندې کې د مشرتوب وړتیا او ښه مشورې ورکولو ځانګړتیا لري.

in_english.name: Ibrahimah
in_english.meaning: Feminine form of Ibrahim, meaning leader or chief of the community
in_english.long_meaning: Ibrahimah is a feminine given name derived from Ibrahim, which originates from the Arabic root 'أ-ب-ر-هـ' (a-b-r-h). This root conveys meanings related to 'father' or 'leader'. In Islamic tradition, Ibrahim (Abraham) is revered as a prophet and messenger. The name Ibrahimah symbolizes leadership qualities, maternal instincts, and spiritual strength. Historically, the name Ibrahim has been significant in Islamic heritage, and its feminine form, Ibrahimah, embodies the virtues of compassion, guidance, and community leadership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ibrahimah holds significant cultural value in the Islamic world, as it is closely associated with one of the most esteemed Prophets in Islamic tradition, Prophet Ibrahim (also known as Abraham in Judeo-Christian traditions). He is recognized as a crucial figure in monotheistic religions due to his unwavering commitment to God and being the father of Ishmael and Isaac, who are regarded as founding figures of two major Islamic tribes, the Arabs and the Hebrews, respectively. This name is a reminder of Ibrahim's legacy, emphasizing the importance of family and faith.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ibrahimah signifies spiritual leadership and compassion, inspired by the Prophet Ibrahim (AS) himself. In Islamic tradition, Prophet Ibrahim (AS) is considered to be a model of courage, deep faith, and devotion to God. His unwavering belief in the One God even in the face of adversity, as well as his ability to lead his family to faith, demonstrates the spiritual power and significance of Ibrahim's life. The name Ibrahimah, which shares the same historical and spiritual foundation as its masculine counterpart, evokes strong spiritual connotations, inviting those who bear the name to embody the qualities of courage, leadership, and compassion.
